the top ten critical success factors for ERP projects in the Canadian Oil & Gas Industry are: Know your data; Longer and more integrated testing; Utilization of the right people; Longer stabilization period (hypercare); Communication; Address legal and fiscal requirements; Hypercare must be longer; Early buy-in from the business; Have a Lean Agile program; Less customization and more vanilla (out of the box); and Project must be business driven and not IT driven.
